title: Predictive information, decoder limitations, and complete cost across two forecasting settings
phase: Prospective protocol only. Benchmark execution belongs to Step24.
study_question: Under a fixed validation policy, when do normalized KAHM states support useful forecasting, and can score-retaining or coordinate controls distinguish actionable finite-predictor limitations?

known_prior_outcomes.step22: 72 new fits; 9 evaluated selected models; 0 accuracy passes, 6 storage passes, 0 joint passes on an already observed ECG cohort.

benchmark_contracts.controlled_units: Five independently seeded train/validation/test replications of one fixed four-state law, not five different laws.
benchmark_contracts.real_unit: One building and one chronological record; windows within a role are dependent.

geometry.minmax_policy: Primary candidate and first deterministic tie order, not a fixed global winner. No clipping of later inputs to [0,1].
geometry.support_constant_axes: Preserve inherited geometry scaler: set constant support axes to zero for every query; record this separately from no-clipping policy. Same geometry scaler semantics for Nystrom.
geometry.head_constant_axes: Training-only ridge standardization uses divisor1 on constant axes; preserve any future variation before the fixed readout.
geometry.local_dimension_rule: min(requested_cap, ambient_dimension, retained_local_reference_count-1), with inherited numerical rank policy; requested and realized ranks recorded.
geometry.reference_cap: 20 implements the user reference min(20,n,N-1), not presumed optimal.
geometry.geometry_seed: Per task as listed; native block seed = geometry_seed % 2**31 + 104729*(block_index+1). Same partition/references for all caps.
geometry.fitting: Pinned Step6/native geometry algorithm, learned partition only; full KMeans, max_train_per_cluster=Nb=24, max_fit=512, model_dtype=float64, inherited float32 reference rounding, singleton augmentation0.05. Fit maximal cap and refit lower caps on exactly the same retained reference arrays. No task-target labels used.
geometry.unused_regrouped_controls: Not candidates. If the inherited fit_family constructs them, record their compute separately; they cannot enter selection.
geometry.actual_block_mismatch: Stop if actual block counts differ from2,4,8,16; do not relabel or shrink the roster.

representations.construction: In each J-wide block: c=clip(s,0,1); u=1-c+tau; v=log(u); eta=omega*v; m=logsumexp(eta); P=exp(eta-m). H is the nonconstant Sylvester Walsh matrix; r=H*v/J.

primary.P: Concatenated normalized probabilities, including allJ coordinates in each block.

score_control.CS: Concatenated clipped scores; no concentration parameter or duplicate omega search.

representations.diagnostic_binding: Use the scaling, cap, prefix, and concentration of the primary-horizon global P accuracy winner. Fit the fixed six heads for each of LR0,LRM,LW; reuse the six P and six CS heads already fitted at this same geometry. Select ridge and HGB separately within each matched view.
representations.exact_equivalence: Canonical P and LR0 have equal information; CS, LW, and LRM have equal information at fixed geometry/omega. This is an exact-real identity, not equality of finite decoder classes or floating representations.
representations.underflow_policy: Do not floor or renormalize rounded probabilities. Logsumexp is required, but final binary64 P may contain zeros at omega64. Record zeros, positive range, clipping counts, and discrepancies. Stop on NaN/infinity; zero is an audited finite representational outcome, not silently repaired.
representations.claims: Neither a finite-head mass gain nor an oracle gap proves unrestricted information loss. Nominal P-vs-LR0 differences can include coordinate, training, and rounding effects.

readouts.common_target_map: Per horizon, fit mean and population standard deviation from head-training labels only; divisor1 if constant. Every fitted family shares this map. Invert before the task output map and physical-unit loss.

ridge.objective: mean squared standardized-target error + alpha*||w||^2, unpenalized intercept
ridge.feature_map: mean and population SD fitted to head-training features only
ridge.solver: sklearn Ridge cholesky, sklearn alpha = n_training*declared_alpha
ridge.deployment: Fold the head scaler and target inverse into deployed coefficients/intercept when applicable; retain any nonfoldable encoder input scaler. Audit the exported predictor on all validation rows; future evaluation uses that frozen export.

hgb.deployment: Retain full TreePredictor structured node arrays plus all prediction-required maps, base value, and target inverse. No post-test pruning or alternative exporter.

readouts.fit_failures: Fail the entire task/run with a recorded cause; do not silently discard a candidate, replace settings, shrink references, or tune to runtime. Operational resumption may continue identical unfinished work. Scientific fixes require a versioned amendment before new test access.

comparators.raw_features: Exactly the same permitted raw history/covariates as KAHM; raw ridge fits its own training standardizer; raw HGB uses these raw coordinates.

nystrom.landmark_order: The same512 reference bank, with declared priority order; use its firstm rows.
nystrom.bandwidth: Let d2 be all strictly positive pairwise squared Euclidean distances in the scaled512-row reference bank. gamma = multiplier / median(d2). If there is no positive distance, stop; no fallback.
nystrom.features: K_XZ * W^(-1/2), where W=K_ZZ is symmetrized and every eigenvalue is floored at1e-12*lambda_max; stop if lambda_max is nonpositive/nonfinite. Use a fixed symmetric eigensolver.
nystrom.deployment: Collapse W^(-1/2), fitted feature standardization, ridge coefficients, and target inverse into m kernel coefficients and an intercept. Retain scaled landmarks, input scaler, gamma, coefficients and intercept; do not charge an unused dense W to this compact query implementation. Retain W as training evidence only.

comparators.baseline_tie_order: raw ridge, raw HGB, Nystrom candidate order; then persistence, daily seasonal where applicable, training mean. No data-dependent rearrangement.

budget.reuse: Cache identical geometry/scores/features within development; reuse Nystrom kernel/decomposition across penalties. This does not waive full end-to-end deployment cost.
budget.interpretation: Fixed-budget panel; search opportunities, capacities, and compute are explicitly unequal across model families.

selection.loss: Primary-horizon validation MSE after frozen export, target inverse, and task output map; HMM [-1,1] clipping, Appliances max(0,prediction_Wh) without upper clipping.
selection.tie_break: Exact equality of stored nominal validation MSE: candidate index. Never inspect test outcomes to break a tie.
selection.C_accuracy: Minimum validation MSE across ALL comparator candidates, including unfitted task baselines.

allowance.meaning: A prospective operational tolerance, not a statistical significance or equivalence margin inferred from data.

selection.C_cost: Among ALL comparator candidates within the validation cap, minimize (complete_numeric_bytes, validation_MSE, candidate_index).
selection.P_accuracy: Minimum validation MSE across432 P candidates.
selection.CS_accuracy: Minimum validation MSE across144 CS candidates.
selection.P_cost: Among P candidates within the same validation cap, minimize (complete_numeric_bytes, validation_MSE, candidate_index); none if empty.
selection.CS_cost: Analogous separate selector for CS. Its success cannot be attributed to normalized P.
selection.primary_roster: Union of P/CS ridge and HGB global winners; P_cost and CS_cost when present; each fitted comparator family accuracy winner; C_accuracy and C_cost; all unfitted baselines; five matched views P,CS,LR0,LRM,LW with ridge and HGB winners each. Deduplicate by exact candidate id; never by rounded forecasts.
selection.secondary_roster: Take every distinct fitted primary-roster configuration. At each secondary horizon transfer scaler, geometry, prefix, concentration, representation, head family and hyperparameters unchanged; refit only the head and common horizon-specific training target map. No secondary validation selection. All unfitted baselines/oracle receive their declared horizon. Max21 unique fitted configuration references before deduplication yields max42 secondary fits/task.
selection.fit_seal: Seal selected ids, fitted payload hashes, all validation predictions, secondary configurations, implementation/environment manifest, and fit inventory before generating/parsing any test numeric observation or derived predictive feature; integrity-only header/timestamp access is permitted.

utility_rule.type: Observed primary-horizon operational screen, not a population noninferiority theorem.
utility_rule.cost_reference_test_risk: Always report it, even if C_cost fails the test accuracy cap. The reference may not be replaced by another test winner.
utility_rule.no_qualifying_model: Record no qualifying candidate and screen failure. If a trivial comparator leaves no possible storage saving, retain that outcome without fallback.
utility_rule.cross_task_rule: Report P_cost and CS_cost separately. Call a procedure consistently successful on this panel only if it passes all three primary gates in ALL five HMM replications AND the Appliances task. Partial passes remain mixed evidence; do not average a failed task away.
utility_rule.claim_limit: Even six passes concern one controlled law and one building; no general superiority across dynamical systems, buildings, or seasons.

risk_and_numerics.primary_estimand: Risk of the frozen exported operational predictor actually evaluated and timed, under its declared floating-point feature construction; not a hypothetical real-arithmetic predictor.
risk_and_numerics.risk_accumulation: Store binary64 forecasts and retained binary64 target values; HMM symbols are exactly representable, while Appliances targets are parsed as binary64. Treat those retained operational numbers as exact dyadic rationals for independent squared-error replay; this is not a claim of exact decimal-source physical measurement. Export outward binary64 bounds. For the11/10 comparison use an exact rational multiplier. Resolve pass/fail using exact risk differences; if an implementation only provides overlapping enclosures, report unresolved, not pass.
risk_and_numerics.oracle: Exact rational same32-observation Bayes conditional mean/variance, evaluation-only. Report realized test MSE, mean exact conditional regret (f-mu)^2, and mean conditional variance separately. A realized MSE difference is not identically conditional regret.
risk_and_numerics.canonical_information_diagnostics: Exact P/LR0 and CS/LRM/LW identities refer to canonical mathematics. To assert a canonical-risk or pure-coordinate diagnosis, reuse/extend the inherited score/transform/head enclosures and independently audit their validity. Otherwise restrict conclusions to the frozen operational procedures and report rounding differences. Numerical intervals are never confidence intervals.
risk_and_numerics.required_manufactured_implementation_che: Validate all four block widths including16 (the existing Step22 wrapper only accepts2,4,8), selected export algebra, normalization/underflow cases, full cost inventory, metadata disjointness, candidate roster, and no unintended outcome access. Seal the later runner/source before development use.
risk_and_numerics.test_replay: Independent prediction/metric replay for every selected model; record any cache-vs-fresh discrepancy. No changed-feature tree discrepancy can be treated as unchanged predictions without analysis.

statistical_reporting.controlled: Report all five replication MSEs, exact conditional-regret sample means, equal-weight aggregate, minimum/maximum and standard deviation. No formal population confidence or significance claim in this panel. Sample means of conditional regret still have finite-history sampling uncertainty.
statistical_reporting.real: Report all3768 test origins, the26 fixed144-origin blocks and final24 origins separately. Blocks are descriptive, not independent observations or confidence intervals.
statistical_reporting.mechanism_claim: A finite matched-head gain is a usable hypothesis about this procedure. It does not identify unrestricted representation loss, guarantee sufficiency, or transport a Lipschitz class across coordinates.
statistical_reporting.engineered_fixture: Four exact score states with scale-relevant risks1 vs0 and scale-ancillary risks0 vs0 validate an elementary normalization example only. No learned KAHM is asserted to attain these scores.

cost_and_timing.numeric_storage: Inventory the entire single deployed model: encoder references/bases/coefficient matrices, scaler offsets/divisors/masks, retained centers, representation constants and Walsh arrays where retained, head parameters, full tree structured fields, target inverse and output-map numeric parameters. Count each retained array/scalar once; no cross-model amortization. No free unreported encoder.
cost_and_timing.timing_input: The same already-available raw feature rows; begin before model-specific input scaling, encoding, representation, head, target inverse and output map. Raw history-window construction is common and measured separately. No cached geometric or Nystrom features.
cost_and_timing.rows: First512 test anchors in fixed roster order; single-query descriptive panel uses first32.
cost_and_timing.timing: Record one cold batch after imports, then one untimed warm-up; run nine warm512-row batches, ascending model-id order on odd repeats and reverse on even repeats. Use perf_counter_ns; primary cost metric is median total ns/512. Retain all nine observations. Single-query panel uses nine repeats over32 individual rows and is descriptive.
cost_and_timing.interpretation: Measured implementation/hardware performance only. Compile/load costs and any canonical assurance work must be recorded separately and cannot be represented as zero.
cost_and_timing.training_cost: Log actual fits, iterations, wall time, geometry and shared computations; no equal-compute claim.

execution_gates: Step23: manufactured checks, independent design review, prospective source/spec/candidate seal, report; no benchmark generation, CSV parsing, or fitting.

Step24 implementation: implement runner under this protocol, manufactured-only numerical/export/access tests, source and environment seal. Changes to scientific choices require a dated amendment before outcome access.

Development: generate HMM support/train/validation only. Stream Appliances header/timestamps and development numeric columns only; do not materialize full pandas dataframes or parse test numeric fields. Enforce archive/schema/cadence integrity and development numeric finiteness before fitting; test numeric finiteness is checked only after the full fit seal and before evaluation. Integrity failure stops the study.
Select and fit all six task procedures plus transferred secondary heads; freeze complete roster and payloads before any test feature/outcome access.
Evaluate each sealed test roster once; independently replay numerical metrics, report all gates and costs, then write results. No outcome-dependent changes.
Keep the5557-row ECG reserve outside this entire study.
deliverables: Prospective PDF, machine-readable protocol and candidate templates, mathematical/source metadata checks, source locks, and a package that reproduces the manufactured checks. No benchmark runner, fitted model, or new forecast result is claimed in Step23.
